evidence.summary: HDU says it has been co-built by Zhejiang Province and COSTIND, the predecessor of the defence-industry regulator SASTIND, since 2007; it lists supporting national defence among its aims and reports two defence-specialty key majors (国防特色重点专业).

Founded in 1956 as the Hangzhou Aviation Industry Finance and Economics School, it was run by the Second and Fourth Ministries of Machine-Building and then China’s electronics and information industry ministries before passing mainly to Zhejiang in 2000.
